clips.title: The story
paras: Along Tirisfal’s main road, Cold Hearth Manor offers travelers a Forsaken outpost west of Brill. The farm once fed Lordaeron, but the Plague of Undeath killed its people and left the fields crawling with Scourge.

Forsaken guards hold the farmhouse at Cold Hearth Manor, west of Brill along Tirisfal’s main road. Before the Third War, the estate was known for warm hospitality and rich harvests in the heart of Lordaeron. When the Plague swept through the kingdom, the family and their laborers died and rose again as husks bound to the Scourge. Feral undead still stumble through the ruined fields, but Forsaken forces drove the mindless dead from the farmhouse. They now use it as a trading post and foothold on the road toward the eastern glades.
